svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Make two. Cut 155 x 50 from 10 mm fabric-ply rubber sheet.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill two 6.5 holes on the centre line, 35 from each end, and

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: counterbore them 13 diameter, 4 deep from the trunk side, so

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the screw heads sit 3 below the rubber face.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Bond to the bar's trunk-side face with contact adhesive, the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: inner end 15 from where the two pad faces would meet.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit M6 x 30 countersunk stainless screws through the pad

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: into the rivet nuts in the bar face, with threadlocker.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Replace a pad that is torn, glazed or soaked in oil.
